title: Understanding Unified VLMs: From Attention Probing to Guidance Tuning for Multimodal Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) generation with one shared Transformer backbone, yet how the backbone processes the condition in either direction remains poorly understood. We study this question from the perspective of conditional guidance: we probe every attention head to show the activation difference between two branches of classifier-free guidance (CFG) with different conditional guidance. On two unified VLMs of autoregressive and masked-diffusion paradigms, the probing reveals a subset of heads that are more sensitive to the change of condition while others are agnostic to it. This characteristic pattern holds in both T2I and I2T generation and is largely stable across data samples, demonstrating the internal mechanism of unified VLMs. Motivated by this, we propose a new inference-time intervention approach for unified multimodal generation, named \textit{HeadTuned-CFG}

translated_title: 理解统一视觉语言模型：从注意力探测到面向多模态生成的引导微调
translated_abstract: 统一的视觉语言模型（VLM）通过同一个共享的Transformer骨干网络同时执行文生图（T2I）和图生文（I2T）生成，然而该骨干网络在两个方向上如何处理条件输入仍知之甚少。我们从条件引导的视角研究这一问题：我们探测每一个注意力头，以展示在具有不同条件引导的无分类器引导（CFG）两个分支之间的激活差异。在两种分别基于自回归和掩码扩散范式的统一VLM上，探测揭示出一部分对条件变化更敏感的注意力头，而其余注意力头对条件变化不敏感。这一特征模式在T2I和I2T生成中均成立，并且在不同数据样本间基本保持稳定，从而揭示了统一VLM的内部机制。受此启发，我们提出了一种新的面向统一多模态生成的推理时干预方法，名为HeadTuned-CFG
tldr: 该论文通过探测统一视觉语言模型中各注意力头在无分类器引导（CFG）两个分支下的激活差异，发现了对条件敏感的注意力头子集这一跨生成方向且跨样本稳定的内部机制，并据此提出了推理时干预方法HeadTuned-CFG以优化多模态生成。
en_tdlr: This paper probes every attention head in unified VLMs to reveal a stable subset of condition-sensitive heads underlying classifier-free guidance across both T2I and I2T generation, and based on this finding proposes HeadTuned-CFG, a new inference-time intervention for unified multimodal generation.
